entries.note: Sakamoto 2011 abstract (PMID 21575866) verbatim. Alectinib, oral, ALK-rearranged biomarker_selected; untested opener (no dosed-human readout) holds; year 2011 matches epub.

Friboulet 2014 abstract (PMID 24675041) verbatim. Retro, retrodiction true: ceritinib phase 1 responses in crizotinib-relapsed patients preceded the cells. Ceritinib oral; crizotinib-relapsed patients make stage_or_line right.

Shaw 2019 abstract (PMID 30892989) verbatim. Lorlatinib oral; patients compared by ALK mutation status after second-gen TKIs, so biomarker_selected fits (stage_or_line also defensible). Gainor 2016 cells predate lorlatinib patient data: same holds.
Sakamoto 2011 abstract verbatim. Alectinib oral, ALK-rearranged biomarker_selected; untested opener holds.
Ceritinib PharmR (bundle 205755) verbatim. Ceritinib oral; ASCEND-1 ALK-rearranged patients, biomarker_selected. Exposure margin stated in model, dose reached: same holds.

Lorlatinib multidisciplinary review (bundle 210868) verbatim. Lorlatinib oral, ALK-rearranged biomarker_selected. Same holds; note's 'lowest dose above Ceff' overstates (100 mg chosen on tolerability too).
Sakamoto 2011 abstract verbatim. Alectinib oral, biomarker_selected; untested opener holds. Note: this xenograft first ran after crizotinib's ALK+ NSCLC responses were public (see efficacy 2).

entries.rule: engagement/efficacy retrodiction: a model first public after a patient result on the same target (member or not) is a retrodiction; reproduced -> retro, never same
entries.note: Seto 2013 abstract (PMID 23639470) verbatim; primary ORR, crizotinib-naive ALK+, alectinib oral, biomarker_selected correct. But Sakamoto 2011 xenograft post-dates crizotinib's ALK+ NSCLC responses (Kwak, NEJM 2010): same target, so retro.
entries.adjudication_note: Retrodiction rule: for efficacy, a model first public after a same-target patient result 'from a member drug or any other drug' is a retrodiction. Sakamoto 2011 post-dates crizotinib's ALK+ responses (Kwak 2010) and reproduced them: retro.

entries.note: Friboulet 2014 abstract verbatim. Retro, retrodiction true: ceritinib phase 1 responses by mutation status preceded the cell work. Ceritinib oral; crizotinib-resistant patients make stage_or_line right.

Peters 2017 abstract (PMID 28586279) verbatim; ALEX primary PFS in untreated ALK+ patients: alectinib oral, biomarker_selected. 2015 intracranial-model superiority claim predates any alectinib-vs-crizotinib patient result (J-ALEX 2016): same holds.
Shaw 2019 abstract verbatim. Lorlatinib oral; ALK-mutation subgroups after second-gen TKIs coded biomarker_selected, defensible. Gainor 2016 model predates lorlatinib patient data: same holds.
NCT01283516 title verbatim, first posted 2011-01-26. Ceritinib oral; ALK-abnormal tumours, biomarker_selected. Untested opener holds (tox data unpublished then).
Ceritinib PharmR (bundle 205755) verbatim. Ceritinib oral, ALK-rearranged biomarker_selected. Rat/monkey GI and liver flags matched clinical harms: same holds.
Alectinib PharmR (bundle 208434) verbatim. Alectinib oral, ALK-rearranged biomarker_selected. Monkey heart-rate fall matched clinical bradycardia: same holds.
Brigatinib multidisciplinary review (bundle 208772) verbatim. Brigatinib oral, ALK-rearranged biomarker_selected. Same with partial (early pulmonary events only loosely flagged) holds.
Lorlatinib multidisciplinary review (bundle 210868) verbatim. Lorlatinib oral, ALK-rearranged biomarker_selected. Cholesterol rises seen in animals and clinically: same holds.
Lee 2023 (PMC10664561) full text verbatim. Alectinib oral, ALK-rearranged biomarker_selected; untested opener for the alectinib PDO track holds.

Lee 2023 full text: alectinib-treated LC_01T PR, LC_03PE PR, LC_08PE resistant; CODRP called all three, quote verbatim. Alectinib oral, biomarker_selected, n=3; patient outcomes predate the paper: retro, retrodiction true holds.
Recondo 2019 full text (PMC6942925) verbatim. Lorlatinib oral; lorlatinib-progressing MATCH-R patients make stage_or_line right. Untested opener; year 2019 epub, print 2020 correct.
Recondo 2019 full text verbatim (MR135-R2 PDX). Lorlatinib oral; MR135 progressing on lorlatinib: stage_or_line. PDX built after the patient progressed: retro, retrodiction true holds.
Ceritinib ClinPharmR (bundle 205755) verbatim. Ceritinib oral; healthy-subject DDI data coded unselected (no healthy-volunteer code). Steady-state PBPK prediction never measured: untested holds.

Alectinib ClinPharmR (bundle 208434) verbatim. Alectinib oral, healthy subjects coded unselected. Retro, retrodiction true: model verified on alectinib's own completed NP28990/NP29042; partial fits rifampicin-M4 miss.

Lorlatinib review (bundle 210868) verbatim. Lorlatinib oral, healthy subjects (B7461012) coded unselected. Retro, retrodiction true: same drug's completed DDI study preceded FDA's model; partial for rifampicin under-prediction. Own lorlatinib track correct.

entries.rule: same/contra from a pairing whose trial source attributes the result to conditions the model never tested should be untested
entries.note: Yang 2023 abstract (PMID 37574132) verbatim; brigatinib oral, crizotinib-pretreated stage_or_line correct, year 2023 epub. ALTA-3 was not ALK-mutation-selected; the panel's mutant ranking was never compared with patients, so contra is unsupported.
entries.adjudication_note: Efficacy population rule plus rule 5: the panel's ranking concerns crizotinib-resistant ALK mutants; ALTA-3 was not mutation-selected (mutants well under 80%), so no trial measured the prediction. Untested, not_measured.

entries.note: Lee 2023 full text verbatim; brigatinib dosed on ALK-positive and negative PDOs. Brigatinib oral, biomarker_selected; untested opener for the split brigatinib PDO track holds.

Lee 2023 full text verbatim: LC_02 SD after resection, LC_09PE PR on brigatinib; both organoids called sensitive. Outcomes predate the paper: retro, retrodiction true. Brigatinib oral, biomarker_selected.

missing: ALTA-3 head-to-head (NCT03596866, results posted 2025-02-19; Yang 2023 J Thorac Oncol doi 10.1016/j.jtho.2023.08.010, PMID 37574132): brigatinib not superior to alectinib after crizotinib, PFS HR 0.97, futility met. The Ba/F3 mutant panel (brigatinib FDA review Table 4, bundle 208772) ranked brigatinib above alectinib across mutants; no entry records this within-class miss, and the context note's 'every track matched' overstates.

Patient-derived organoid track, ALK-positive NSCLC (J Exp Clin Cancer Res 2023, doi 10.1186/s13046-023-02899-4, 8 patients): the conventional AUC readout did not separate responders to crizotinib/alectinib/brigatinib; a growth-rate-weighted index (CODRP) matched clinical responses. A retrodictive patient-level comparison with no model_id in the draft (retro or contra by readout).

Low confidence: a CKB entry (https://ckb.jax.org/profileResponse/show/25891) reports alectinib failing in an ALK I1171N/F1174I PDX; the primary paper was not resolved within budget, so an alectinib PDX comparison may exist.
not_owed: EML4-ALK transgenic/GEMM (Soda 2008, cited in the brigatinib review) was dosed only with crizotinib and TAE684, non-members; the 2023 orthotopic murine EML4-ALK alectinib study (PMID 36739466) is mechanistic, not compared with patients. No track owed.
Members iruplinalkib and foritinib have no entries; no failure or model comparison was found for them, so no status changes.
rule_questions: Within-class head-to-head: when the model ranked one member above another (Ba/F3 panel: brigatinib > alectinib) and the trial found no difference (ALTA-3) while the class still works, does the ranking miss score contra on that track, or is it outside class-level efficacy?

Patient-level predictions and endpoint_role: when the test is the primary endpoint (ORR) analysed by predicted genotype (Shaw 2019), is endpoint_role 'primary' or null? The rules only define primary/poc_gate for class-level calls.
model_kind has no value for engineered cell lines (Ba/F3); 'ex_vivo' implies patient material. Is one slug covering engineered Ba/F3 mutants plus patient-derived resistant lines one system or two?

Engineered-mutant xenografts (Ba/F3 or NIH3T3 EML4-ALK G1202R in mice, the source of lorlatinib's Ceff) sit between the NSCLC-cell-line xenograft track and the mutant-cell track; which model_id owns them?
Engagement by response rate: when no human PD readout (tumour pALK) exists, may mutant-bearing patients' ORR stand in as a 'downstream' engagement readout, or does engagement stay untested?

A single paper that reproduces a known clinical result (retro) and also makes a new prediction tested in the same paper by resistance-biopsy enrichment (G1202R): one entry or two, and does an in-paper resistance correlation count as an efficacy comparison at all?

PBPK DDI models in the dose cell (alk-pbpk-ddi): decision 4 scores whether the model's exposure target was reached and sufficient; a PBPK DDI model predicts a co-medication exposure ratio and is verified against DDI studies already in the NDA, so the track can only ever be retro or untested. Does it belong in dose, and is prediction_level 'class' right for a drug-level PK prediction (neither 'does the class work' nor 'which patients respond')?

One organoid system, two readouts (alk-nsclc-pdo-codrp, Lee 2023): the conventional AUC mis-called the only non-responder while the paper's post-hoc regression-fitted CODRP index (which includes clinical stage) matched 5/5. Is the track scored on the pre-specified readout (#110, contra) or on the index the paper proposes (retro), or are these two tracks under decision 8?

PDX-derived cell lines (Recondo 2019 MR57-S, lorlatinib-sensitive at IC50 50 nM while patient MR57 progressed): owned by the PDX track (alk-lorlatinib-resistant-pdx) or by the patient-derived resistant-lines track (alk-mutant-cells)?

Efficacy 2 (fields pass): the alectinib xenograft (Sakamoto 2011) post-dates crizotinib's ALK+ NSCLC responses (2010). Does a non-member, multi-target ALK inhibitor's patient result make a second-generation member's class-level xenograft a retrodiction, or only for the patient population crizotinib was tested in?
